title: Italian Crumble Bread
description: A traditional Italian dessert with a crumbly topping and a soft bread base.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the fermented milk and sugar.
Add the melted butter and mix until well combined.
Gradually add the bread flour and mix until a dough forms.
Transfer the dough to a greased 8-inch round baking dish.
In a separate bowl, mix the crumble topping ingredients.
Evenly spread the crumble topping over the bread dough.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the crumble topping is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes.
